documents.title: BGB §167
documents.text: Authority is granted by a declaration to the representative or the third party. The actual scope and any special procedural requirements require lawyer review; a generated draft does not establish authority.

documents.title: RVG §3a
documents.text: The provision generally calls for text form, a clearly identified separate remuneration agreement, separation from the power of attorney, and a warning concerning limits on reimbursement. Applicability and exceptions require lawyer review.

documents.title: RVG §9
documents.text: An appropriate advance may be requested for incurred and expected fees and expenses. A five-hour demo calculation does not establish that five hours is appropriate or that services have been performed.

documents.title: BRAO §43a
documents.text: The provision addresses professional confidentiality and conflicts involving representation in the same legal matter. Intake alone does not establish that confidentiality controls or a conflict check have been completed.
